stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Serious issues often live in details.”?
options: A city that ignores toilets may look modern while making daily life harder for many people.
Technology can support good habits, but it should not become an excuse to stop looking, smelling, planning, and thinking.
Instead of only telling people where to walk, the city studied where people already walked and built a better way.
Reading only summaries is like looking at a city from an airplane: useful for shape, poor for street life.
